accounts.csv.account_id: Unique fictional account identifier (e.g. ACC_00001). No connection to real institutions or individuals.
accounts.csv.account_type: Entity operational classification: Retail Consumer, Small Business, Merchant, or Corporate Treasury.
accounts.csv.country_code: Jurisdiction of account domicile (ISO alpha-2 code: US, GB, CA, CH, KY, CY, PA).
accounts.csv.risk_rating: Baseline Know-Your-Customer (KYC) compliance risk rating (Low, Medium, High).
accounts.csv.open_date: Date the fictional account was opened (YYYY-MM-DD).
accounts.csv.is_synthetic_mule: Boolean ground-truth indicator showing whether this account was designated as a synthetic money mule in a laundering network.

transactions.csv.timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of transaction settlement (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).
transactions.csv.sender_account_id: Originating account foreign key referencing accounts.csv(account_id).
transactions.csv.receiver_account_id: Beneficiary account foreign key referencing accounts.csv(account_id).
transactions.csv.payment_method: Payment rail: Wire Transfer, ACH, P2P Instant, Cash Deposit, or International Swift.
transactions.csv.is_laundering: Ground-truth benchmark indicator: True if part of an illicit money laundering pattern; False otherwise.
transactions.csv.laundering_pattern: Specific financial crime typology: Normal, Circular Loop, Fan-Out Smurfing, or Fan-In Aggregation.
transactions.csv.ring_id: Identifier of the laundering syndicate/ring referencing laundering_rings.csv, or 'NONE' for legitimate activity.

laundering_rings.csv.ring_id: Unique identifier for the synthetic financial crime syndicate (e.g. RING_CYCLE_01, RING_SMURF_01).
laundering_rings.csv.pattern_type: Typology topology: 'Circular Loop' (directed closed cycle) or 'Fan-Out Fan-In Smurfing' (structured star network).
laundering_rings.csv.cycle_length: Number of directed hops in closed circular loop (0 for star-shaped smurfing structures).
laundering_rings.csv.member_count: Total count of participating distinct accounts (originators, mules, and collectors).
laundering_rings.csv.total_volume_usd: Aggregate initial illicit capital channeled through the syndicate structure, fictional USD.
laundering_rings.csv.member_accounts: Comma-delimited sequence of participating account IDs.
